products.items.page.title: Products
products.items.page.description: Own-product master: identity and SKU, customs and unit, packing and volume, variants, and the cost / internal settlement / export price tiers — one catalogue for purchased and self-made goods.
products.items.list.emptyHint: Create the first product — its identity, SKUs and price tiers — to start building the own-product library.
products.items.list.columns.name: Name
products.items.actions.deleteConfirmBody: The row is soft-deleted and its code stays reserved. Contracts and invoices that already reference it keep their own snapshot.
products.items.distribute.title: Distribute to organizations
products.items.distribute.description.on: The selected organization receives this product (fields, variants and a first price set). Running it again updates the fields — prices belong to the receiving organization.
products.items.distribute.description.al: The selected organizations receive every active product of this organization. Running it again updates the fields — prices belong to the receiving organization.
products.items.distribute.empty: No organization can receive products: you can only write into organizations your role grants, and never into the current one.
products.items.distribute.skipped: {{sku}} — skipped: the organization already owns this SKU
products.items.form.createPricesFailed: The product was saved, but its prices were not. Correct them and save again.
products.items.form.field.name: Name
products.items.form.field.brandHelp: The brand owner for a purchased line, our own brand for a self-made or commission-produced one; leave blank when there is none.
products.items.form.field.manufacturerMo: The model printed on the contract line, e.g. W5C.
products.items.form.field.skuHelp: Our code for this item: unique inside the organization and never reused — including by a deleted row.
products.items.form.field.specSummaryHel: Specification printed on contracts and declarations, e.g. White / 1.5L / with filter.
products.items.form.field.unitHelp: Options come from the unit dictionary; a code it does not list can still be typed.
products.items.form.priceEmpty: No price rows yet. At least one tier is needed before a contract line can pick a price.
products.items.form.priceHint: Cost price = what we pay: the supplier’s price for a purchased line, the production cost for a self-made one. Internal settlement price = what we charge the subsidiary; export price = what the subsidiary charges its customers.
products.items.form.pricePermissionDenie: You cannot maintain prices, so this list is read-only.
products.items.form.priceLoadFailed: Could not load the price rows
products.variants.title: Variants / SKU
products.variants.description: The sellable units of this product. A code is unique inside the organization (soft-deleted SKUs keep theirs) and the default variant is what a stock receipt books against when nothing more specific is chosen.
products.variants.defaultHint: At most one SKU can be the default; leaving none selected is fine.
products.variants.field.name: Name
products.variants.error.duplicateCode: Code {code} is used by more than one SKU of this product
products.common.notAuthorized: You do not have permission for this feature. Ask an administrator to grant it.
